verdicts.reason: A is unusable. Its elements are scattered with no order: the legal line sits at the top, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' falls below the body copy, the RSVP button and the chips are tiny and spread around the bottom, the product can has shrunk to a speck, the logo is buried, and a large grey missing-asset box is visible. B keeps the product can at a good size and a readable right-hand text column, but its hierarchy is still broken. The RSVP CTA is shrunk into a chip-sized pill and jammed against the top-right edge next to the badges. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below its own headline. The body lines are stacked tightly with uneven spacing, and the legal text is too small to read at this size.
